verdict.rationale: Operating a cloud email service through natural-language commands is a fair axis for this kind of product. However, the evidence documents only SDK, SMTP and API access, which are programmatic interfaces, not natural-language operation. The llms.txt and markdown-docs probes make the documentation easier for LLMs to read, but they do not let users operate SES in natural language, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
